relevance_note: Single-family report of ABCA1 splice variants with individual genotypes in Table 4: "presence or absence of ABCA1 splice variants of the low HDL pedigree".
method_note: Read by hand; a short script assembled the JSON. Labels D1-D6 are the paper's own labels from Table 4 ("Proband (D3)" etc.); the text refers to D3 only as 'the proband'. Two untested relatives described with premature CHD (maternal grandfather, MI at 35; 'maternal brother', PCI at 56) are included as relatives of D3; the 'maternal brother' cannot be D5 (age 43) and is read as a separate person (likely mother's brother, not stated). CONTRADICTION: Table 4 column header prints 'IVS7+6c>t' while the text prints 'IVS7+6t>c' / 'IVS7 +6t>c' and describes a T->C change; the text nomenclature is used for all variant rows. No c./p. HGVS or transcript is printed. Variant carriage of D1, D2, D4, D5, D6 is read from the Yes/No columns of Table 4. Proband inheritance (IVS7 paternal, IVS31 maternal) rests on Table 4 Father/Mother rows; inheritance for D4, D5, D6 left not reported (parentage relative to D1/D2/D3 not stated explicitly). Zygosity for relatives not stated, left not reported; proband recorded compound heterozygous from 'located on opposite chromosomes' / 'biallelic', although the Discussion contrasts the case with 'compound heterozygotes' from earlier reports. 'All family members had reduced HDL-C and apoAI' applied as a group statement to D1-D6 only (the measured relatives in Table 4), not to the grandfather or maternal brother. 'The proband's parents are both living and without symptomatic CHD as are his 2 siblings' applied to D1, D2 and to D4, D5 (Table 4 lists exactly one sister and one brother). Absence of symptomatic CHD was not used to exclude the broader checklist item 'coronary artery disease'. 'No hepatosplenomegaly' was not used to exclude splenomegaly or hepatomegaly separately; 'no diabetes mellitus' was not used to exclude glucose intolerance; 'mucosal discoloration' was not mapped to tonsils. 'Did not exhibit any of the known clinical features of this disorder' is recorded as stated and not mapped to specific checklist items. Table 4 lipid values (e.g. TG, LDL) are not interpreted as high/low since the paper does not characterise them. 'resident of Virginia, USA' is residence, not origin, so ethnicity_or_country is not reported. n_patients_reported left null: authors state 'Family members with low levels of HDL-C (n = 6) were screened' but no count of carriers (Table 4 shows 6 carriers). Controls (20 and 100 unrelated subjects) and the 20 unrelated probands mentioned in the Discussion are out of scope.

the first splicing defect (IVS7 +6t>c)

functional_evidence_statement.value: cDNA from the proband: exon 7 skipping in one allele, eliminating 59 amino acids in the first extracellular loop without frameshift or premature truncation; splice-site analysis predicts a decrease in splice-site strength from 10.2 to 8.8 bits; minigene assay detected only 2–3% defective product
span: Subcloning of alleles confirmed Exon 7 skipping in one allele that resulted in the elimination of 59 Amino Acids in the first extracellular loop of the ABCA1 protein but did not result in a frameshift or premature truncation
Analysis of the IVS7 +6t>c mutation predicts a decrease in the strength of the splice site, from 10.2 bits to 8.8 bits of information
the IVS7 mutation did not reveal the level of mis-splicing anticipated from cDNA analysis because only 2–3% of defective product was detected

gene_symbol_as_stated.span: Two novel splice variants in ABCA1were identified

span: (Nomenclature IVS31-1g>c)
Two novel splice variants in ABCA1were identified
The second mutation was a single base pair change (G->C) at IVS 31 -1, at the intron/exon junction of exon 32

functional_evidence_statement.value: skipping of exon 32, 8 novel amino acids then a stop codon, predicted protein 1496 AA vs 2261 AA; information analysis predicts complete loss of splice-site recognition; minigene: mutant construct 98% aberrantly spliced product A, mutation completely abolishes normal splicing
span: This mutation causes skipping of exon 32, resulting in 8 novel amino acids followed by a stop codon with a predicted protein size of 1496AA, compared to normal (2261AA)
Information analysis also predicts the complete loss of splice site recognition for IVS31-1g>c
This demonstrates that the mutation in question (IVS31-1g>c) completely abolishes normal splicing
the mutant construct revealed 98% of aberrantly spliced product A by densitometry
